summary: Submitted the discriminating experiment for the recorded lag question 6464ac4e45e546e99aff4d88c0a145c8-question-0: a 4-node cluster in the extended-window per-node timing (leader 20s, near 6s, far voters 3s, only the leader bootstrapped) with a committed DemoteVoter transition, sampling every node's own GetConfiguration view of the demoted peer's suffrage and its LastIndex every 20ms for ten seconds, repeated in three runs. Each node's emitted event separates the competing explanations: a view that stays old while the node's LastIndex never reaches the configuration entry is a delivery stall, while a view that stays old after the log already contains that index would point at configuration-entry processing; six comparisons encode the convergence prediction and that consistency check per run. Native local execution of exactly this harness converged in 0-21ms for all four nodes in 3/3 runs with no index-passed-while-stale case, so I expect the formal receipt to bound the earlier single sighting as not reproduced under this construction; the interpretation will be written once the receipt exists, and the VerifyLeader finding is unaffected either way.
